_comment: VIEWER (Kessig Wolf Run): the human makes BOTH of the pump's choices. Under human play the
engine offers every legal X (0 included); the target is chosen on the live board when it activates. Here
the OTHER sources (Mountain + two Forests) pay {R}{G} plus at most one more: X = 0 or 1, at Courser of
Kruphix or Avenger of Zendikar (the opponent has no creature). A bare `cast=Kessig Wolf Run` (the verbless
land convention) must resolve to a `choose` over EXACTLY 2 X variants. The target is a later board click.
